title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.

Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.

How You'll Help Us Connect the World:

You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.

Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.

Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.

Required Qualifications for Consideration:

  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.

Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.

RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.

Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.

Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.

Required Qualifications for Consideration:

  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.

Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.

RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance

  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process ✅

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

title: Data Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

3–5 years of experience in data engineering roles.

At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark.

Strong programming skills in Python.

Proficiency in SQL and experience working with both relational and non‑relational databases.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Azure certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Databricks certifications.

Experience with streaming data processing (e.g., Structured Streaming, Event Hubs).

Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt or ARM templates).

Familiarity with data governance tools and practices.

Experience with Unity Catalog, data governance, and data security/compliance concepts.


Job Description


Insight Global is seeking a Data Engineer to support a large beverage company’s data and analytics initiatives. This delivery-focused role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, including Unity Catalog. The Data Engineer will develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines and Apache Spark jobs, ensure data quality and reliability, and collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.


This is a remote role in Brazil.

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Job Title: Java Developer

Location: Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica

Work Mode: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to join a dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java 8+ , relevant frameworks ( Spring, Hibernate ), relational databases, RESTful APIs, version control, and basic frontend knowledge. This role requires problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java 8+ and frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
  • Work with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL , and write optimized queries.
  • Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Use version control tools like Git for collaboration and code management.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React .
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications.
  • Work with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence for task and project tracking.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and a dynamic work environment.
  • Communicate effectively with teams and stakeholders.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Java 8+ and frameworks ( Spring, Hibernate, etc. )
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and web services
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies ( HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React )
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly in a dynamic environment

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Strong collaboration in cross-functional and remote teams

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in a relevant field
  • Technical certifications related to Java development are highly recommended

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina

Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.

Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.

  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.

Required expertise in:

  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design

Preferred Skills:

  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: Médico Especialista em Demência – Papel Consultivo (Dedicação Parcial)
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ está desenvolvendo um modelo estruturado de coordenação de cuidados em demência , apoiado por tecnologia, para famílias que convivem com Alzheimer e outras demências no Brasil.

Nosso programa atua entre as consultas médicas , oferecendo monitoramento contínuo, suporte ao cuidador, coordenação de telemedicina e navegação estruturada do cuidado. A plataforma combina protocolos clínicos, ferramentas digitais, telemonitoramento e apoio baseado em inteligência artificial para ajudar famílias a lidar com os desafios médicos, comportamentais e práticos da demência.

O modelo é inspirado em iniciativas internacionais de coordenação de cuidado em demência, como o GUIDE Model (EUA) , adaptado ao contexto brasileiro.

Estamos atualmente em fase piloto , construindo o primeiro modelo operacional do programa e formando o primeiro Care Pod da Kuidar+.


Sobre a função

Buscamos um médico(a) com experiência em demência para atuar como Médico Advisor da Kuidar+ em regime de dedicação parcial.

Esta não é uma posição assistencial e não envolve consultas ou atendimento médico direto aos pacientes.


O papel combina dois objetivos principais:


Governança clínica

Apoiar a validação clínica do modelo de cuidado, garantindo que protocolos, critérios de triagem e fluxos de segurança estejam alinhados às melhores práticas no cuidado de pessoas com demência.


Desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado

Contribuir para o desenho e evolução do modelo de coordenação de cuidados da Kuidar+, incluindo o uso de telemedicina, monitoramento remoto e ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial .

O profissional poderá ser apresentado publicamente como Clinical Advisor da Kuidar+ , contribuindo para a construção da arquitetura clínica do programa.

Com a evolução da empresa, poderá também participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento clínico da plataforma e do modelo de cuidado .


Responsabilidades

  • Revisar e validar protocolos clínicos utilizados no programa
  • Contribuir para a definição de critérios de triagem e escalonamento clínico
  • Oferecer orientação à equipe multidisciplinar em situações clínicas mais complexas
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de casos
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado e das estruturas de segurança clínica


Dedicação

Aproximadamente 2–4 horas por semana , com atuação predominantemente remota.

A colaboração poderá iniciar em formato pontual por advisory , com possibilidade de evolução para retainer mensal conforme o programa se desenvolva.


Requisitos

  • Médico(a) com especialização em Geriatria, Neurologia ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência clínica
  • Experiência no cuidado de pacientes com demência, Alzheimer ou transtornos cognitivos
  • Capacidade de colaborar em ambiente multidisciplinar
  • Conforto para comunicação em inglês


Por que esta posição é interessante

  • Participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência no Brasil
  • Contribuir para protocolos clínicos que apoiam cuidado longitudinal fora do ambiente hospitalar
  • Trabalhar na interseção entre medicina, tecnologia, telemedicina e inteligência artificial
  • Colaborar com um time internacional e multidisciplinar

﻿

Resumo honesto

Estamos no começo.

O modelo ainda está sendo construído.

Esta não é uma posição clínica tradicional em hospital ou consultório. É uma oportunidade de participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência , combinando prática clínica, tecnologia e coordenação estruturada do cuidado.

Se você tem experiência concreta na área e interesse em inovação em saúde, gostaríamos de conversar.


Como se candidatar

Candidaturas podem ser enviadas pelo LinkedIn.

– Experiência no desenvolvimento de integrações backend

– Vivência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e mensageria

– Experiência com ambientes cloud

title: Independent M&A Partner
description:
Junte-se à Elite Global: Escale sua Prática de M&A no Coração Econômico da América Latina

Eleve sua assessoria ao aderir à rede de M&A internacional mais prestigiada do mundo.

O ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida Partners de M&A, MDs e boutiques financeiras baseadas em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e nos hubs do Agronegócio a integrarem nossa rede de alto desempenho. Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica de parceria para profissionais independentes que desejam alavancar uma marca global e uma infraestrutura de banco de investimento de classe mundial.

title: SR Desenvolvimento .NET
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos profissional de nível sênior especializado no desenvolvimento .NET e experiência na execução de testes que tenha disponibilidade para atuar em um projeto pontual (temporário).

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e migração de aplicações back-end e integrações de sistemas
  • Participar da análise técnica de soluções e estimativas
  • Garantir qualidade e boas práticas de codificação
  • Apoiar na construção de testes e integração contínua

Requisitos:

  • Vivência com .NET (desejável .NET Framework e/ou .NET Core)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração contínua como Jenkins
  • Controle de versionamento com GitLab
  • Integrações e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com IA será um diferencial
  • Experiência em arquitetura e migração de soluções para cloud, com foco em Azure, incluindo Azure Functions, AKS e Logic Apps

title: PLM Consultant | Windchill | Remote – Brazil
description:
PLM Consultant | Windchill | Remote – Brazil

Estamos em busca de um PLM Consultant para atuar em projetos de consultoria e implementação utilizando a suíte PTC Windchill . Esse profissional será responsável por apoiar iniciativas de Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) , colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e contribuindo para a entrega de soluções eficientes para clientes globais.

Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar projetos de consultoria e implementação de PLM utilizando PTC Windchill

• Analisar requisitos de negócio e colaborar na implementação de soluções junto a equipes técnicas e funcionais

• Participar de workshops e sessões de levantamento de requisitos com clientes

• Contribuir para a definição de soluções técnicas e funcionais em ambientes PLM

• Apoiar atividades de planejamento, análise, desenvolvimento e testes dentro dos projetos

• Executar tarefas técnicas como instalação, configuração e suporte do sistema PLM

• Identificar gaps entre requisitos do cliente e funcionalidades do sistema, propondo soluções adequadas

• Atuar em atividades de debug, migração de dados, infraestrutura e deploy

• Garantir qualidade seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software

Requisitos:

• 2 a 5+ anos de experiência em PLM , preferencialmente com PTC Windchill

• Experiência em projetos de implementação de PLM

• Conhecimento em administração de sistemas, Windows Server e Linux (Red Hat)

• Experiência com Java, SQL ou Python

• Experiência com integrações utilizando Webservices, XML, JSON ou OData

• Conhecimento em Oracle ou SQL Server é um diferencial

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas

Idiomas:

• Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório)

• Espanhol é um diferencial

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams

Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga

Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;

Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga

Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;

Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.

You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.

Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.

Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.

This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments

More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams

Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.

Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.

Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.

Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.

Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos

Para mais informações, assista ao nosso

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour

We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.

We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.

About the Role

You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:

  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance

This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:

  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Buscamos profissionais para atuar no time de Engenharia de Cloud responsável por desenho, migração, implementação e sustentação de ambientes em nuvem (Azure ou AWS).

Você trabalhará em um contexto altamente automatizado, seguindo padrões corporativos e boas práticas de arquitetura, operações e governança, apoiando a evolução contínua dos ambientes e aplicações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Migração e Implementação

  • Conduzir migrações de workloads do on-premises para cloud
  • Implementar novas soluções em nuvem desde o desenho até a entrega
  • Criar ambientes base e automatizar provisionamentos

Operação e Sustentação

  • Resposta a incidentes e gestão de problemas em serviços cloud
  • Monitoramento de infraestrutura e aplicações
  • Gestão de patches e manutenções programadas
  • Administração de backup e recuperação
  • Gestão de requisições de mudança (change requests)
  • Otimização de performance e custos
  • Manutenção corretiva/evolutiva e redução de dívida técnica

Plataforma e Integrações

  • Orquestração e gestão de containers (Kubernetes)
  • Manutenção de integrações e APIs
  • Automação de processos e infraestrutura

Colaboração e Governança

  • Seguir padrões e processos corporativos definidos

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .

description:
Project description

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve daily FO issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing
  • Liaise with technical team(s) -
  • when needed -
  • to resolve FO related issues and necessary enhancements
  • Develop FO Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along
  • Yield Curve management and validation; curve assignments; new curve creation
  • Products (IRD, CRD, EQD) management and validation
  • Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various FO deliverables
  • Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving request or issues with P&L, Market Data, and booking issues
  • Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
  • Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally
  • Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

Skills

Must have

  • Very Strong product knowledge in IRD, CRD, EQD, FX
  • Very strong understanding of IRD, CRD, EQD, FX business
  • Very Strong understanding on P&L concept overall and its components
  • Very Strong understanding and hands-on experience in Market Data, Curve structure, Simulations, and Trade Life Cycle
  • Strong analytical, pricing, and conceptual skills
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues
  • Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing)

Must:

  • 6+ years experience on Murex with FO functionalities/module
  • experience in financial markets
  • Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
  • Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
  • Possess good verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have strong organization skills

Nice to have

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent
  • Implementations and upgrades of vendor packages like: Calypso, Open Link, Summit, ...etc.
  • Test management
  • Trade life cycle management
  • Market Data management
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Excelian's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

Languages

English: C2 Proficient

Spanish: C2 Proficient

Seniority

Senior
